method: Separate reading against source, test/check logs, posted comment receipts and independent review findings
score_reason: Concrete source and evidence details; required section structure accounts for repeated report scaffolding
confidence_reason: Self-assessment with inspected source evidence; no calibrated style benchmark

examples.cue: Located concrete verification or scope statement
examples.impact: Limits the claim to what was checked
examples.quote: Acceptance: tests and source checks support each claimed fix, documentation

science_gate_reason: No claim of broad calibration or method superiority; unresolved scientific questions remain explicit
facts_gate_reason: File list, source/check outcomes and issue comments compared with retained evidence; CI remains explicitly pending
references_gate_reason: No external literature claim; repository pointers and PR identity checked as facts
